# Meghanath Macha

Head of AI & Platform at ZeroToOne.AI. Behavioral foundation models and ML platforms.

- Website: https://mmacha.github.io/
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/meghanathmacha/
- Google Scholar: https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=XNzyEd0AAAAJ&hl=en
- Email: meghanath.macha@gmail.com

## Now

Architects ZeroToOne's Large Behavioral Model, the platform unifying physical and digital
behavioral traces across 1.8B+ devices and generating 10B+ daily predictions for Fortune 500
marketing intelligence. Led technical diligence on ZeroToOne's acquisition of GroundTruth and
WeatherBug; leads the platform integration.

## Previously

At Adobe, led GenStudio's guideline-aware AI systems, delivering semantic knowledge graph
grounding that enabled Adobe's first fully AI-generated marketing campaign and a 60% content
velocity improvement. Earlier, founding ML engineer at ZeroToOne.AI and research scientist at
Adobe Research India.

## Research

Carnegie Mellon Ph.D. in privacy-preserving behavioral modeling. Published in ISR, DMKD, KDD and
Management Science with 300+ citations. M.Sc. and B.Sc. in Mathematics and Computing from the
Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur.

## Patents

9 granted patents, 15+ filed across behavioral ML, GenAI, and privacy.
